class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

def convertToDLL(root):
    if not root:
        return None

    def extractLeaves(node):
        if not node:
            return None, None

        if not node.left and not node.right:
            return node, node

        left_head, left_tail = extractLeaves(node.left)
        right_head, right_tail = extractLeaves(node.right)

            left_tail.right = node
            node.left = left_tail

        if right_head:
            right_head.left = node
            node.right = right_head

        if left_head:
            return left_head, right_tail or node
        else:
            return node, right_tail

    head, tail = extractLeaves(root)
    return head

def printInorder(root):

    while head:
        print(head.data, end=" ")
        if head.right:

        head = head.right
    print()
